Debrief DB-021
1) The actor fabricated a workplace injury narrative, leaving a documented scheme behind, while bypassing the mandatory verification of actual event circumstances.
2) They coached a coworker to provide false corroborating statements, creating a record of coordinated misrepresentation, without undergoing the standard conflict-of-interest review for witness integrity.
3) The actor directed a medical professional to manipulate clinical documentation, resulting in a trail of fraudulent medical records, while evading the required peer-review validation of diagnostic findings.
4) They submitted the inflated claim to the insurer, generating an audit trail of deceptive filings, without accepting the prerequisite good-faith declaration for claimant honesty.
5) The actor attempted to prepare for the insurer's investigation, establishing a pattern of obstruction planning, while ignoring the legal obligation to cooperate transparently with the claims review process.
